### Timothy’s Visit to Thessalonica
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/timothy-visit-to-thessalonica
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 3:1-3
Points:
- Paul deeply cared for the young church and sacrificed having his key co-laborer Timothy at his side.
- Timothy was dispatched to establish and strengthen the Thessalonians in their Christian walk.
- Believers must recognize that suffering and affliction are an expected part of Christian discipleship.
- Paul's personal endurance under persecution served as an example for the congregation to imitate.
- Living faithfully during hardships provides a powerful testimony that fortifies the faith of others.

### Quiet Walk - November 3
Author: Walk Thru the Bible
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/quiet-walk/quiet-walk-nov-3-11558545.html
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 3:2-3
Points:
- Paul sent Timothy to strengthen the church because he feared for their spiritual well-being.
- Affliction is an unavoidable reality of life that arrives through various sources.
- Believers experiencing trials have a profound need for spiritual encouragement to stand strong.
- While counsel and correction are valuable, offering encouragement remains one of the most powerful ministries.
